A short notice about leash checks
It is for pet owners

Leash Checks for Boarding Travelers

Travelers need to keep pets on a secure leash or in an approved carrier before check-in at Aurelia Skyways.

The Companion Animal Travel Desk is handling active leash checks now. Staff will review restraint fit, animal comfort, and safe handoff steps. If a passenger is worried, the welfare coordinator and supervisors will listen and guide the next step. <<FACT F012>> Keep collars snug and tags visible so records stay clear. Bring any required papers and stay near the pet during review.

Use the pet relief area only as directed and follow the posted entry rules. <<FACT F017>> Keep the area clean, calm, and supervised at all times. If a pet needs separation or special care, staff may move the case to a holding space. <<FACT F026>> Please do not delay at the counter if your animal needs attention.

Report at once to the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
